senses.gloss:
धुक्ष r. 1st cl. (धुक्षते)
 1. To kindle.
 2. To be weary.
 3. To live. भ्वा० आ०
अक० अनिट्.

धूक्ष r. 1st cl. (धूक्षते)
 1. To live.
 2. To kindle.
 3. To be disinterested.

धूक m. (-कः)
 1. The air or wind.
 2. A rogue, a cheat.
 3. time.
 E. धु
to agitate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
